notes: Whole-sign houses from Lagna; kendra = 1/4/7/10, trikona = 1/5/9.
Sambandha (relationship) here = conjunction, mutual kendra, or exchange of signs; documented per yoga.
Interpretive weight is traditional lore, labeled as such — the engine computes presence, never destiny.
source: Definitions per Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra (BPHS) and Phaladeepika as commonly transmitted; chapter-verse numbering varies by edition and is therefore cited by work rather than verse

budha_aditya.name: Budha-Aditya Yoga
budha_aditya.rule: Sun and Mercury occupy the same rashi
budha_aditya.signification: Intellect joined with authority; skill in counsel and learning
variants: Some schools require the two within a stated orb rather than the same sign; the sign rule is the common textbook form

dhana.name: Dhana Yogas
dhana.rule: Lords of the wealth houses (2, 5, 9, 11) in sambandha — conjunction, mutual kendra/trikona, or exchange of signs
dhana.signification: Accumulation of wealth through the houses and lords involved
variants: Many specific Dhana yogas exist (e.g. 2nd+11th, 5th+9th lords); this engine reports every qualifying pair among 2/5/9/11 lords

gaja_kesari.name: Gaja Kesari Yoga
gaja_kesari.rule: Jupiter in a kendra (1, 4, 7, 10) from the Moon
gaja_kesari.signification: Wisdom and standing; traditionally 'the elephant among lions'
variants: Some texts add freedom from combustion and malefic association; reported here as the positional core only

kemadruma.name: Kemadruma Yoga
kemadruma.rule: No planets in the 2nd and 12th from the Moon, the Sun excepted
kemadruma.signification: Traditionally loneliness of the Moon; independence bought at a price
variants: Bhanga (cancellation): Moon in kendra from Lagna, or Jupiter aspecting/associated with the Moon — reported as flags, never silently applied

pancha_mahapurusha.name: Pancha Mahapurusha Yogas
pancha_mahapurusha.rule: Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus or Saturn in own or exaltation sign in a kendra from Lagna — Ruchaka, Bhadra, Hamsa, Malavya, Shasha respectively
pancha_mahapurusha.signification: Great-person combinations; each planet's highest worldly expression
pancha_mahapurusha.source: BPHS / Brihat Jataka, as commonly transmitted
variants: Some schools reckon kendras from the Moon as well; Lagna kendras are the standard form implemented here

raja.name: Raja Yogas (basic)
raja.rule: A kendra lord and a trikona lord in sambandha (conjunction, mutual kendra, or exchange); the 9th+10th lord combination is the premier form and is flagged
raja.signification: Elevation, authority, the rise of fortune
variants: The literature names dozens of Raja yogas; this engine implements the core kendra-trikona sambandha rule

sakata.name: Sakata Yoga
sakata.rule: Jupiter in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Moon
sakata.signification: Fortune that rises and falls by turns; resilience tested
